Late last night, helpful news for people travelling soon
It concerns the desk

Urgent Notice for Travellers With Pets

Travelers need to know that the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways is handling pet travel checks with extra care right now. Please bring every pet document, carrier detail, and health note to the desk before you head to departure.

The team is working through routine safety reviews and making sure each booking is clear before animals move on. A safety coordinator is checking for hazards and prevention points, while trained staff give patient attention to every animal that comes through. This is shared work, and it helps keep each journey calmer for you and for your pet.

If you are bringing a cat, dog, or other approved companion, keep the carrier ready, stay nearby, and listen for guidance from the counter staff. Small details matter, and missing papers or unclear plans can slow things down fast. If you need help with the next step, the desk will sort it out with you.

Please go straight to the Companion Animal Travel Desk for support now.
